# `auth.logout`

Sign out

Revokes the current session and clears the session cookie.

- Method and path: `POST /logout`
- Scope: `public:read`
- Kind: `mutation`
- CLI: `rukie auth logout`
- MCP: `auth_logout`
- Idempotency-Key: required on this mutation

## Inputs

| Name | In | Required | Type |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Idempotency-Key` | header | no | `string` |

## Errors

Framework problems only.
